blog_summary: Adrian Colyer highlights the HotOS'19 conference as having an 'incredible crop of papers' and expresses regret that he couldn't cover more of them in his blog. He specifically mentions several papers from the conference, including one on unikernels and another on the 'fork()' system call, suggesting these are noteworthy topics. The post serves as a brief interlude before a four-week break, encouraging readers to explore the HotOS'19 proceedings themselves to discover interesting research.
